answer: One defense is a reputation lagoon: new agents start on a small island of trust with tiny transaction limits, and only earn access to the wider ocean of the economy by completing verified work over time. A sybil spawning a hundred fake identities must age and fund each one separately, so the cost of building a credible army scales with the number of sockpuppets while an honest agent pays once. Identities that attest garbage are sunk back to the lagoon, making cheap mass forgery unprofitable.
